project.name: WebAssembly4J :: wasmos-runtime generated bindings
project.description:
Java bindings generated by webassembly4j-bindgen from wasmos:runtime@0.2.0 — the portable, backend-agnostic runtime API that wasmos adapters (adapter-wasmtime, adapter-wamr, adapter-js) implement (see ~/git/wasmos). The initial slice binds the six interfaces that make up the core runtime surface:
* core — core-Wasm compile / instantiate / invoke * component-model— rich CM management API * run — one-shot fire-and-forget execution * capabilities — cap-set definitions * info — supports() / version() introspection * types — portable value / capability / error types
Plus the transitive tegmentum:common/errors dep that types.wit pulls in.
The remaining wasmos:runtime interfaces (http, http-streaming, websocket, timers, provider-manifest) are excluded from this slice until bindgen learns to map deeply-nested container record fields cleanly — see the parent's task ledger.
The content of this module is the generated source tree under ai.tegmentum.wasmos.runtime.generated plus a local copy of WitResult so the jar has no compile-time or runtime dependency on webassembly4j-bindgen (which is a maven-plugin-packaged build-time-only artifact). Providers that implement the wasmos:runtime SPI depend on this module for the generated surface + WitResult.
Regenerate with:
java -jar webassembly4j-bindgen/target/webassembly4j-bindgen-2.5.2-SNAPSHOT-cli.jar \ -w ~/git/wasmos/wit/deps/tegmentum-common \ -w ~/git/wasmos/wit/deps/wasmos-runtime/types.wit \ -w ~/git/wasmos/wit/deps/wasmos-runtime/capabilities.wit \ -w ~/git/wasmos/wit/deps/wasmos-runtime/core.wit \ -w ~/git/wasmos/wit/deps/wasmos-runtime/component-model.wit \ -w ~/git/wasmos/wit/deps/wasmos-runtime/run.wit \ -w ~/git/wasmos/wit/deps/wasmos-runtime/info.wit \ --package ai.tegmentum.wasmos.runtime.generated \ --output wasmos-runtime-generated/src/main/java \ --no-impl \ --runtime-provider WasmosRuntime
